messages:
Alex W: Heads up — I opened a docs PR that outlines our recommended aliasing strategy for the upcoming model swap and the v1->v2 SDK break. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/789 (draft)
Maya R: thanks — reading now. Does this cover streaming framing changes? iirc v2 sends chunks with `delta` keys.
Chris P: It does, but I added a small snippet to show how to handle partial deltas in py-ts examples.
Alex W: snippet's great, can we also show a tiny fallback snippet for older v1 clients that expect bare strings?
Chris P: added fallback example:
```python
# v1-compatible collector
text = ''
for chunk in resp.stream():
    text += chunk.get('delta', '')
```
Maya R: looks good. pls also add a note about token accounting differences — users may see small billing diffs after swap.
DocsBot: PR #789 created by @alexw · automated spellcheck passed · linked issue #456
Sophie L: product note — we should put a 90-day deprecation window and email customers who have >10k calls/mo to recommend dedicated capacity or pinned model versions.
Tony (Eng): confirmed deploy plan: stage rollout in us-west first, alias map -> redirect for 24h, then hard swap. We'll keep a fallback to `model-compat-v1` for 7 days.
Maya R: can we get a quick checklist in the PR description for docs reviewers? e.g., update quickstart, update SDK snippets, add migration FAQ entry
Alex W: done — checklist in PR desc. tagging @Sophie L for customer comms copy review.
Sophie L: will review by EOD. propose short "what to expect" bullet points + two example notices (tech & non-tech).
Chris P: one more ask — update the typescript example to use `await stream.text()` pattern we introduced in v2 to avoid double-await confusion.
Maya R: added the ts change. also fixed a bad link to old endpoint in the "model map" page.
Alex W: awesome. once Sophie signs off i'll request reviews from eng-runtime and sdk teams. thanks everyone :rocket:
Tony (Eng): leaving a note in release-war-room about the aliasing window
Alex W: closing loop — will merge after sign-offs and send a deploy calendar invite.
